items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I asked Max Roach once... Max called me and he said, 'Charles, are you ok?'... You know Max and Dizz and Bird - how they were like my deities

ctx.x: And he said he was a meteor, he went fast man. And so that was that. Then he would... Then Sonny knew of him, and Max had heard him through Brownie and all that.
